scope: Exact provisional Isaiah 53:11 source and English under the updated policy; not earliest-text certainty, exhaustive translation comparison, or deployed-reader verification.

source_distinction_checks.source_evidence: ועונתם הוא יסבל; the independent הוא makes the servant the expressed subject of bearing their iniquities.
source_distinction_checks.proposed_text: From the anguish of his soul he will see light[a] and be satisfied; by his knowledge[b] my righteous servant will justify many, and he will bear their iniquities.
source_distinction_checks.alternative_text: From the anguish of his soul he will see light[a] and be satisfied; by his knowledge[b] my righteous servant will justify many, and he himself will bear their iniquities.
source_distinction_checks.rationale: The alternative explicitly intensifies the subject and is viable. Retain he because the transition from many/their to the servant is expressed by the repeated English subject, whereas himself selects stronger contrastive emphasis that the independent pronoun does not uniquely establish. This is a comparison-based preference, not a rejection because the alternative is unfamiliar or already recorded.

source_distinction_checks.source_evidence: מעמל נפשו יראה אור ישבע בדעתו; the proposed Hebrew contains אור without an added word for life, while בדעתו permits consequential interpretive alternatives.
source_distinction_checks.proposed_text: From the anguish of his soul he will see light[a] and be satisfied; by his knowledge[b] my righteous servant will justify many, and he will bear their iniquities.
source_distinction_checks.alternative_text: After his suffering he will see the light of life[a] and be satisfied; by knowledge of him[b] my righteous servant will justify many, and he will bear their iniquities.
source_distinction_checks.rationale: Retain the current sentence: light preserves the actual noun without making one contextual interpretation part of its wording; From leaves the relation less narrowly temporal than After. His knowledge expresses the supplied base analysis directly, while knowledge of him remains a genuine alternative rather than a grammatical impossibility. This comparison does not settle every possible attachment of בדעתו. The current knowledge note remains correctly anchored and accurate.

source_distinction_checks.source_evidence: יצדיק צדיק עבדי לרבים repeats the צדק root in verb and adjective.
source_distinction_checks.proposed_text: From the anguish of his soul he will see light[a] and be satisfied; by his knowledge[b] my righteous servant will justify many, and he will bear their iniquities.
source_distinction_checks.alternative_text: From the anguish of his soul he will see light[a] and be satisfied; by his knowledge[b] my righteous servant will declare many righteous, and he will bear their iniquities.
source_distinction_checks.rationale: The alternative makes the repeated root more visible and deserves explicit consideration. Retain justify provisionally because declare many righteous narrows the action toward a declarative mechanism, while the verse relates righteousness to bearing iniquities without specifying that mechanism. The current sentence preserves the semantic connection but does not reproduce the repeated English root; that is a disclosed tradeoff, not a claim that the wording pattern has been fully represented.
